caption: The pedal of a bass drum is pressed repeatedly, and the beater swings into the drumhead with each press and the head dips each time.

sa.check: A bass drum with a pedal and a beater.
The beater swings into the drumhead with each press.
The head dips with each hit.
There are several presses in the clip.
Each press comes before its beater swing and dip.

pc.expect: The beater moves only when the pedal is pressed and rests between presses.
pc.fail: The beater swings while the pedal is up and untouched; or moves toward the head before the pedal goes down; or keeps bouncing between presses with the pedal still.

pc.expect: Each time the beater lands the head dips and springs back; no dip without the beater.
pc.fail: The beater lands and the head stays flat; or the head dips while the beater is away from it; or the head stays dented after the beater has left; or the pedal is pressed and the beater does not move.

pc.expect: The beater arcs about its pivot and the pedal hinges at its base.
pc.fail: The beater slides straight toward the head without arcing; or the pedal moves up and down as a whole without hinging; or the beater moves in a different direction from the pedal's press.

pc.expect: The head flexes as a skin and the rigid beater rebounds from it.
pc.fail: The beater sinks into the head and stays; or the head shatters; or the beater rod bends double.

pc.expect: One beater, one pedal, one drum; the beater does not pass through the head.
pc.fail: A second beater appears; or the beater passes through the head; or the drum changes shape; or the pedal vanishes.

pc.expect: The drum's finish, the head's logo and the pedal's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The drum changes colour; or the head's logo changes; or the pedal changes colour.

note: The foot on the pedal is a trigger and is not judged.
